sentence_example: Sie muss täglich den Hof fegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: She has to sweep the yard daily.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей приходится подметать двор каждый день.
sentence_synonym: Sie muss täglich den Hof kehren.
typical_collocations: die Straße fegen; Staub fegen; den Boden fegen; durch die Straßen fegen
usage_comments_en: 'fegen' primarily means to clean a floor or surface with a broom. In Southern Germany and Austria, 'kehren' is much more common for this. Colloquially, it can also mean to move or run very quickly (e.g., 'der Wind fegt über das Feld').

word_translation_en: to sweep off; to sweep clean
sentence_example: Er musste zuerst den Tisch abfegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He had to sweep the table clean first.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Сначала ему пришлось смахнуть крошки со стола.
sentence_synonym: Er musste zuerst den Tisch abkehren.
typical_collocations: Krümel abfegen; den Tisch abfegen; Staub abfegen; Schnee vom Auto abfegen
usage_comments_en: 'abfegen' means to remove dust, crumbs, or snow from a specific surface. It usually takes the surface being cleaned as a direct object in the accusative case.

sentence_example: Kannst du bitte den Dreck auffegen?
sentence_example_translation_en: Could you please sweep up the dirt?
sentence_synonym: Kannst du bitte den Dreck aufkehren?
typical_collocations: Scherben auffegen; Dreck auffegen; den Staub auffegen; Laub auffegen
usage_comments_en: 'auffegen' specifically implies sweeping debris, dirt, or shattered glass together and picking it up (usually onto a dustpan or 'Kehrblech') to discard it.

word_translation_en: to sweep out; to clean out by sweeping
sentence_example: Wir müssen die Garage gründlich ausfegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: We need to sweep the garage out thoroughly.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen die Garage gründlich auskehren.
typical_collocations: die Garage ausfegen; das Zimmer ausfegen; die Werkstatt ausfegen
usage_comments_en: 'ausfegen' means to sweep the interior of an enclosed space, such as a room, garage, or shed, to make sure all accumulated dirt is removed.

word_translation_en: to sweep aside; to brush aside
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она отмела все сомнения в сторону.
typical_collocations: Bedenken beiseitefegen; Argumente beiseitefegen; Zweifel beiseitefegen
usage_comments_en: 'beiseitefegen' is almost exclusively used in a metaphorical sense. It describes quickly and decisively dismissing objections, concerns, or arguments as if they were dust.

word_translation_en: to sweep clean; to sweep bare
sentence_example: Der Sturm hat die Straßen völlig blankgefegt.
sentence_example_translation_en: The storm swept the streets completely bare.
sentence_synonym: Der Sturm hat die Straßen völlig leergefegt.
typical_collocations: die Straßen blankfegen; die Plätze blankfegen
usage_comments_en: 'blankfegen' is used to describe a wind, storm, or event that leaves an area completely empty, clean, or devoid of people. It is very similar to 'leerfegen'.

word_translation_en: to sweep together; to gather by sweeping
sentence_example: Er half mir, das trockene Laub zusammenzufegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He helped me sweep the dry leaves together.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он помог мне смести сухие листья в кучу.
sentence_synonym: Er half mir, das trockene Laub zusammenzukehren.
typical_collocations: Laub zusammenfegen; Schmutz zusammenfegen; Reste zusammenfegen
usage_comments_en: 'zusammenfegen' is used when scattered dry objects (like fallen leaves, dust, or trash) are swept into a single pile for easier collection.

word_translation_en: to sweep through; to sweep thoroughly
sentence_example: Ich muss am Wochenende das ganze Haus durchfegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: I need to sweep through the whole house this weekend.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мне нужно подмести весь дом в выходные.
sentence_synonym: Ich muss am Wochenende das ganze Haus durchkehren.
typical_collocations: das Haus durchfegen; der Wind fegt durch die Gassen
usage_comments_en: Literally means sweeping through an entire space. Figuratively, it can describe a strong wind rushing through a corridor or area, or metaphorically cleansing/reorganizing a system.

word_translation_en: to sweep away; to blow away
sentence_example: Eine Windböe hat die Hüte fortgefegt.
sentence_example_translation_en: A gust of wind swept the hats away.
sentence_synonym: Eine Windböe hat die Hüte weggefegt.
typical_collocations: Staub fortfegen; vom Wind fortgefegt werden; Hindernisse fortfegen
usage_comments_en: 'fortfegen' describes a swift removal of objects, usually caused by natural forces like wind or water. It can also be used abstractly to represent clearing away obstacles.

word_translation_en: to sweep in; to rush in
sentence_example: Der Wind hat den Staub durch das Fenster reingefegt.
sentence_example_translation_en: The wind swept the dust in through the window.
sentence_synonym: Der Wind hat den Staub durch das Fenster hineingetrieben.
usage_comments_en: 'reinfegen' is a colloquial variant of 'hineinfegen'. It means to sweep dirt inside or, when describing persons or storms, to rush dynamically inside.

word_translation_en: to sweep away; to brush off
sentence_example: Die Flut hat das gesamte Dorf weggefegt.
sentence_example_translation_en: The flood swept the entire village away.
sentence_synonym: Die Flut hat das gesamte Dorf weggespült.
typical_collocations: Zweifel wegfegen; Hindernisse wegfegen; Krümel wegfegen
usage_comments_en: 'wegfegen' is highly common. It can be literal (sweeping away debris) or figurative (annihilating opposition, removing doubts, or a natural disaster destroying a structure).

word_translation_en: to start sweeping; to sweep lightly against
word_translation_ru: начинать подметать; слегка задевать при подметании
sentence_example: Er wollte gerade die Garage anfegen, als es anfing zu regnen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He was just about to start sweeping the garage when it started to rain.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он как раз собирался начать подметать гараж, когда пошел дождь.
sentence_synonym: Er wollte gerade die Garage ankehren, als es anfing zu regnen.
usage_comments_en: A relatively rare prefix verb in modern standard German. It denotes starting the act of sweeping or sweeping slightly against something. Often replaced by simple 'fegen' or 'anfangen zu fegen'.

word_translation_en: to sweep away; to rush off
sentence_example: Der Sturm fegte das morsche Dach davon.
sentence_example_translation_en: The storm swept the rotten roof away.
sentence_synonym: Der Sturm riss das morsche Dach weg.
usage_comments_en: Similar to 'wegfegen' and 'fortfegen', 'davonfegen' emphasizes the swift motion of being carried away from its original place. It can also describe a person running away very quickly.

word_translation_en: to sweep near; to rush approaching
word_translation_ru: подметать поближе; приближаться на большой скорости (о ветре/буре)
sentence_example: Ein gewaltiges Unwetter fegte von Westen heran.
sentence_example_translation_en: A powerful storm swept in from the west.
sentence_synonym: Ein gewaltiges Unwetter nahte von Westen heran.
typical_collocations: ein Sturm fegt heran; eine Wolkenwand fegt heran
usage_comments_en: Seldom used for physical broom actions. It almost exclusively describes weather fronts, storms, winds, or fast-moving threats rapidly approaching.

word_translation_en: to sweep down; to rush down
sentence_example: Sie fegte den Schmutz die Treppe hinunter.
sentence_example_translation_en: She swept the dirt down the stairs.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она смела грязь вниз по лестнице.
sentence_synonym: Sie kehrte den Schmutz die Treppe hinunter.
typical_collocations: die Treppe hinunterfegen; den Abhang hinunterfegen
usage_comments_en: Can be literal (sweeping dust or leaves downwards) or describe something moving quickly downwards, like wind blowing down a mountainside or valley.

word_translation_en: to sweep away; to sweep across
sentence_example: Der Taifun fegte über die Insel hinweg.
sentence_example_translation_en: The typhoon swept across the island.
sentence_synonym: Der Taifun raste über die Insel.
typical_collocations: über das Land hinwegfegen; alle Zweifel hinwegfegen; Hindernisse hinwegfegen
usage_comments_en: 'hinwegfegen' emphasizes passing over a large area while destroying or removing everything in its path. Frequently used in journalism for hurricanes, epidemics, or political changes sweeping across regions.
